$ echo hello | sed 's/l/L/'
heLlo
$ echo hello | sed 's/l/L/g'
heLLo
$ echo hello | sed 's|h\(.\)|[\1]|'
[e]llo
$ echo Hello | sed 's/hello/bye/I'
bye
$ printf 'a\nb\nc\n' | sed 2d
a
c
$ printf 'a\nb\nc\n' | sed -n 2p
b
$ printf 'a\nb\nc\n' | sed '$d'
a
b
$ printf 'keep\ndrop me\n' | sed '/drop/d'
keep
$ echo x | sed 's/x/1/;s/1/2/'
2
$ echo 'name=old' > /tmp/c; sed -i 's/old/new/' /tmp/c; cat /tmp/c
name=new
$ echo x | sed 'q'
x
$ sed s/a/b/ /nope
sed: can't read /nope: No such file or directory
[exit 2]
